# Security Policy

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately:

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/TMHSDigital/Static_Chess/security) of this repository
2. Choose **Report a vulnerability**, or go straight to the [new advisory form](https://github.com/TMHSDigital/Static_Chess/security/advisories/new)

Do not open a public issue for sensitive reports.

We aim to respond within 7 days.
